title: Characterization of extension by zero along an open immersion
statement:
Let $j:V\hookrightarrow Y$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion], with extension by zero $j_!:\Ab(V_{\Et})\to\Ab(Y_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] on abelian sheaves of the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], inverse image $j^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and counit $\varepsilon^!_j:j_!j^{-1}\to\mathrm{id}$ of the adjunction $j_!\dashv j^{-1}$ [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction]. Let $F\in\Ab(V_{\Et})$, $H\in\Ab(Y_{\Et})$, and let $a:F\to j^{-1}H$ be an isomorphism. Assume that $H_{\bar y}=0$ for every geometric point $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ [def-weil-geometric-point] whose image point does not lie in $j(V)$ (stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]). Then the morphism adjoint to $a$,
$$
 a^\sharp:=\varepsilon^!_{j,H}\circ j_!(a):\;j_!F\xrightarrow{j_!a}j_!j^{-1}H\xrightarrow{\varepsilon^!_{j,H}}H,
$$
is an isomorphism. (In words: $j_!F$ is the unique abelian sheaf on $Y_{\Et}$ whose restriction to $V$ is $F$ and whose geometric stalks off $V$ vanish, the identification being the adjoint map.)

source.place: Lemma 0F70 (etale-cohomology-lemma-jshriek-open, line 11468), second statement ('j_!F is the unique abelian sheaf on X_etale whose restriction to U is F and whose stalks at geometric points of X \ U are zero') and its proof (the adjoint map is an isomorphism at stalks of geometric points of U by Proposition 03S5, zero off U, then Theorem 03PU, exactness via stalks)
